# inQRedible

> Native iPhone app for creating, customizing, scanning and exporting QR codes and barcodes.

inQRedible is an iOS app for QR code generation, QR reading, barcode generation and barcode scanning. It supports QR templates for URL, text, clipboard, Wi-Fi, vCard, email, SMS, phone, location, calendar events and social profiles including Instagram, Facebook, X, WhatsApp, YouTube, Spotify, TikTok and Snapchat. Barcode generation supports EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 128 and PDF417.

Important facts:
- Website: https://inqredibleapp.com/
- Spanish website: https://inqredibleapp.com/es/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/inqredible/id6748907388
- App Store Spain: https://apps.apple.com/es/app/inqredible/id6748907388
- Platform: iPhone / iOS
- Free download with optional inQRedible PRO subscription managed by Apple.
- QR content, selected images and history are processed locally on the device and are not uploaded to inQRedible servers to generate codes.
- Scanner risk signals are informational only and do not guarantee that a link is safe or dangerous.
